mapper.select:
select avg(case when accept_time is not null and pay_time is not null then timestampdiff(second, pay_time, accept_time) end) as avgAcceptSeconds, count(case when accept_time is not null and pay_time is not null then 1 end) as acceptSamples, avg(case when ready_time is not null and pay_time is not null then timestampdiff(second, pay_time, ready_time) end) as avgMakeSeconds, count(case when ready_time is not null and pay_time is not null then 1 end) as makeSamples, avg(case when ready_time is not null and picked_up_time is not null then timestampdiff(second, ready_time, picked_up_time) end) as avgPickupWaitSeconds, count(case when ready_time is not null and picked_up_time is not null then 1 end) as pickupWaitSamples, avg(case when picked_up_time is not null and delivered_time is not null then timestampdiff(second, picked_up_time, delivered_time) end) as avgDeliverSeconds, count(case when picked_up_time is not null and delivered_time is not null then 1 end) as deliverSamples from biz_order where create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end}
and delivery_type = #{deliveryType}
